scope: Bounded source-clause audit of 2.9–2.28P, visually checked on official Physics specification PDF pages 20–21 / printed 14–15. Continues the separate 2.1–2.8 audit. Practical descriptions and schematic graphs are not evidence of collected experimental results or validated assessment.
identifierPolicy: Requirement suffixes r1, r2, etc. are local editorial audit identifiers; only the parent reference is publisher-numbered.
